rollback.before_enforcement: legacy Engine and current backend completion remain available
rollback.after_enforcement: durably pause the exact physical canary and use the reviewed forward restoration set; never re-enable a legacy or direct-SQL writer
rollback.database: forward-only; do not down-migrate contexts, proofs, reservations, reconciliation, audit, scan evidence, dispositions, or outbox evidence

source_identity.acceptance_input_contract: The cutover invocation must supply a regular, mode-0444, Ed25519-signed release attestation outside this worktree. It binds the semantic release, backend commit/tree/evidence digest/evidence blob, frontend commit, and schema fingerprint. The executable gate deterministically enumerates every tracked path and Git mode from that exact tree, compares every worktree path directly with its exact tree blob and mode, and rejects hidden index flags or Git-environment substitution before any database access. Generated evidence is never its own identity authority.

authority_inventory.include: every regular tracked path in the caller-supplied expected tree
authority_inventory.reason: The generated evidence is separately compared with its exact expected-tree blob and is excluded only to prevent self-reference. All migrations, release inputs, schema-fingerprint inputs, rebuild and database suites, provenance and suite-order gates, final-operational and named-manager gates, generator, checker, package commands, and every other tracked source path are included without a hand-maintained allowlist.

phase_order: prepare distinct CUSTODIAL_BACKEND_PROOF_SECRET and CUSTODIAL_NATIVE_ROUTE_PROOF_SECRET values (minimum 32 characters each) without exposing either value
run npm run release:populated-schema:preflight through the read-only production MCP and preserve its exact source-fingerprint receipt before any migration
verify production project, migration head, catalog/privilege fingerprint, backup receipt, and exact source attestation against release/pending-production-migration-plan.json
apply only the nine hash-bound migrations in release/pending-production-migration-plan.json, in exact order, stopping after any failed phase postcheck
deploy the canonical-only backend only after all authoritative procedures above are present and verified; missing canonical writers fail closed
require a green authority health gate and direct-DML denial probes before routing traffic

rollback.precondition: retain the exact bridge backend artifact and both release secrets until all authority health and restoration probes are green
rollback.action: pause the exact physical canary through the durable control; if canonical authority is missing or broken, restore the captured known-good function set forward, verify health, then explicitly resume
restoration_checks: the designated phone's authenticated native-vault /scan-api/rpc request records an immutable exact-device, credential, backend-commit, and release receipt before canary resume
exact start and completion replay return one durable proof, reconciliation, and completion
offline snapshot activation requires exact issued identity; frozen exact replay remains attributable to the original actor after reassignment
scan evidence remains exact-shape and provenance-labeled after replay
service_role direct insert/update/delete/truncate probes are denied
named-manager reconciliation read, exactly-once disposition replay, and notification retry state remain available
present-but-broken and missing canonical authority functions restore to their captured known-good definitions while the canary remains paused
schedule, turnover, occurrence, and dashboard service dates all change at the same 04:00 America/Chicago boundary
employee and manager notifications use the same service date; activation replay returns frozen actor identity and its rollback definition remains exact
pending phone work reports every issued snapshot employee and assignment epoch separately; legacy aggregate-only reports remain explicitly unbound
offline work begun while snapshot, credential, and assignment authority were valid can activate after reconnect, while work begun after revocation, expiry, or reassignment is rejected
native wire timestamps are canonical UTC milliseconds; immutable activation boundaries and catalog-derived authority restoration remain healthy after negative mutations
complete Weekly Schedule day-change batches pass the database receipt-chain health gate; exact replay is read-only and prefix, extension, reorder, and content conflicts fail atomically

authority_content_identity.binding: The executable cutover gate verifies one external Ed25519-signed release attestation, deterministically enumerates every tracked entry in its exact backend tree, rejects non-regular or symlink authority entries and forbidden index flags, compares every worktree byte sequence and mode with its exact tree blob and mode, and separately verifies this generated evidence file against the signed digest and exact tree blob.

manager_recovery.authority: active named manager; disposition write additionally requires DIRECTOR or SECURITY_ADMIN

release_boundary: Prepare distinct minimum-32-character backend and native-route secrets before cutover; configure their database digests immediately after the migrations that create each configuration function, retain the bridge backend artifact through the scan-snapshot phase, and require the executable health/restoration probes before traffic changes.
